email_subject: Application - Hands-on Marketing Manager at EEVEE Mobility
email_body:
Dear EEVEE Mobility team,

I'm applying for the Hands-on Marketing Manager role. Your mission to electrify Europe's corporate fleets resonates with me, and I'd love to bring my hands-on digital marketing experience to your commercial team.

At Episto, I manage day-to-day SEO, content, and WordPress builds for client sites, and I've used SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Ads to optimise campaigns and report on performance. I also maintain CRM records for a cleaning-services client, keeping follow-up and customer data up to date. On mirook.com, I've executed full-cycle marketing: site design, social media integration, and technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably improved search visibility.

I'm proactive, results-driven, and comfortable juggling multiple projects in fast-changing environments. My Dutch is B1 and improving, and I work professionally in English. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to EEVEE's growth.

Warm regards,

Dear EEVEE Mobility team,

I'm excited to apply for the Hands-on Marketing Manager position. Your mission to accelerate the green transition of Europe's corporate vehicle fleet speaks to me, and I'd relish the opportunity to support your commercial organisation with hands-on marketing execution.

At Episto, I own on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site builds for client websites. I track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads, using those insights to refine campaigns and report on lead generation and engagement. I also work in the CRM for a cleaning-services client, maintaining customer records and follow-up — experience that maps directly to updating your CRM and analysing campaign results.

On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, integrated social media, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably improved search health. That project sharpened my ability to deploy the right channels — social, content, technical SEO — at the right moment, and to stay curious about emerging tools and trends.

I'm a self-starter who thrives in fast-changing environments, sets priorities effectively, and meets deadlines. My Dutch is B1 and improving, and I communicate professionally in English. I'm eager to learn EEVEE's products and market deeply, and to bring fresh ideas to your team.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my hands-on skills can contribute to your growth. Thank you for your consideration.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
